steps.title: Open the target queue
steps.instruction: In the Amazon SQS console, choose Queues and select sqs-beginner-test only.
steps.description: In the Amazon SQS console, choose Queues and select sqs-beginner-test only.
steps.verification: Confirm sqs-beginner-test is the selected queue; do not select messages, other queues, or other AWS resources.

steps.title: Delete the approved queue
steps.instruction: With sqs-beginner-test selected, choose Delete, enter delete in the confirmation dialog, then choose Delete.
steps.description: With sqs-beginner-test selected, choose Delete, enter delete in the confirmation dialog, then choose Delete.
steps.verification: Confirm the deletion action was submitted for sqs-beginner-test only.

steps.title: Refresh and verify removal
steps.instruction: Return to the Queues list and refresh it after deleting sqs-beginner-test.
steps.description: Return to the Queues list and refresh it after deleting sqs-beginner-test.
steps.verification: Visibly confirm that sqs-beginner-test is no longer listed.

steps.title: Manual cleanup acknowledgement
steps.instruction: Record that the Stage 8 manual Console cleanup check is complete for sqs-beginner-test.
steps.description: Record that the Stage 8 manual Console cleanup check is complete for sqs-beginner-test.
steps.verification: Confirmed sqs-beginner-test is no longer listed after refresh and no other resources were selected for deletion.

guidancePreservedFromStage7.task-sqs-receive-and-inspect-the-test-me: A future CLI path must retain the ReceiptHandle returned by receive-message for the later delete-message command.
guidancePreservedFromStage7.task-sqs-delete-the-received-test-messag: A future CLI path must use the most recently returned ReceiptHandle with delete-message.
guidancePreservedFromStage7.task-sqs-review-queue-deletion-effects-0: A future CLI cleanup path may use delete-queue only in Stage 8.
guidancePreservedFromStage7.task-sqs-confirm-safe-scope-and-required: A future CLI path may use --region eu-west-2 and must still rely on access already granted by the learner's administrator.

manualReviewFindings: An exact least-privilege policy must not be inferred. The learner must use an account or role already authorized for the required SQS Console actions.
Standard queues use at-least-once delivery and can occasionally return messages out of order; use one harmless test message and do not claim exactly-once or ordered delivery.
A Console-retrieved message is not deleted automatically and must be selected and deleted after verification.
FIFO-only requirements remain outside this standard-queue Follow Along.
Receipt-handle capture is preserved only for a future CLI path and is not required by the Console instructions.
Stage 6 provides queue lifecycle awareness only; actual manual queue deletion belongs to Stage 8 cleanup.

The accepted sources identify SQS permissions and actions but do not support an exact Console-only inspection that proves the signed-in identity has every required permission before performing the tasks.
The accepted Console receive/delete documentation does not support capturing a receipt handle in the Console; no transient receipt-handle resource was captured.
Cleanup remains manual-only and is limited to deletion of sqs-beginner-test.
No messages, other queues, IAM resources, or other AWS resources are included.
